messages:
Alex: Proposal: region-aware routing + latency-based region selection for hosted API. Default behavior: honor preferred_regions but auto-switch if p95 to preferred_region > 150ms. Also fall back to model variants when capacity is constrained. Thoughts? :thinking:

Maria: +1. Two things we need up front: (1) telemetry with per-request routing_reason, not just final region; (2) clear quota/billing semantics when traffic crosses regions.

Sree: Agree. Also KV-cache affinity is critical. If we hop regions we lose warm KV and could see transient p99 spikes. Need to factor warm_kv into decision.

Jen: UX note: customers need control. Console toggle + API flag. Defaults: off for Private, on but conservative for Hosted. Enterprise should be able to opt-out for data residency.

Alex: Proposed policy shape (YAML example) — per-customer: preferred_regions (ordered), allow_cross_region (bool), latency_threshold_ms, fallback_model_priority (list). Also tier_overrides for enterprise. Edge will make the quick decision; control-plane will supply capacity hints.

OpsBot: Audit: when allow_cross_region=false we persist a policy lock. Audit entry created.

Maria: Telemetry fields to emit per request: routing_decision={preferred_region|latency_failover|capacity_failover|tier_escalation}, chosen_region, origin_edge, latency_ms_probe, fallback_model. Console should break down p95 by routing_decision.

Sree: Implementation question: selection at edge (low-latency, local probes) vs centralized control-plane (global state + cost rules). Edge reduces RTT and complexity, control-plane gives better global optimization.

Jen: My preference: edge-first selection using recent RTT probes + cached capacity hints from control-plane. Keeps fast-path local but respects global constraints.

Alex: Example YAML we want to canary:

```
routing_policy:
  preferred_regions: [us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1]
  allow_cross_region: true
  latency_threshold_ms: 150
  fallback_model_priority:
    - redwood-xl-q8
    - redwood-xl-q4
    - redwood-large
  tier_overrides:
    enterprise:
      latency_threshold_ms: 300
      allow_cross_region: false
```

Maria: Add header X-Redwood-Routing-Reason for internal traces. Also dashboard: p95 by chosen_region, fallback_rate, count by routing_decision.

Sree: For KV affinity: edge should consult cache_hit_ratio_last_1m. If >60% prefer staying local even if latency slightly > threshold. Also penalize moving if estimated_warm_kv < 0.5.

Jen: Rollout UX: region-by-region canary. Start with 5% traffic in us-west-2, monitor p50/p95, fallback_rate, error_budget. One-click rollback in console. Surface "fallback frequency" and "cost delta" metrics prominently.

Alex: Rollout gating rules: p95 latency, fallback_rate, error_rate. Example: rollback if fallback_rate > 10% over 10m. We'll hook into existing rollouts panel.

Maria: Edge-case: strict residency. If customer sets strict_residency=true and target region lacks requested model variant, we either deny or serve a same-region smaller variant. Need explicit semantics.

Infra: We need a tiny proto between edge and control-plane for capacity hints: {region, model, available_slots, estimated_warm_kv}. Keep it minimal to avoid churn.

Jen: Dashboard ask: show cost impact per routing decision. If routing to a higher-cost region, show estimated delta per 1k tokens so customers can understand billing impact.

Alex: For canary: I'll build a test harness that simulates varying KV-warmth and inter-region RTTs, then injects load to trigger fallbacks.

Sree: I'll prototype the edge heuristic and open a proto PR for capacity hints.

Maria: I'll draft dashboard queries and a template: p95(latency) by chosen_region, count() by routing_decision, fallback_rate.

Jen: UX mocks: policy editor with YAML import/export, a toggle "Auto region routing", rollout controls, and a cost-impact preview. I'll add rollback button and a small help bubble explaining residency implications.

Alex: Action items:
- Alex: draft canary config + test harness (due EOD +2)
- Sree: proto + edge cache-affinity prototype (due EOD +3)
- Jen: console mocks + rollout UX + cost preview (due EOD +4)
- Maria/Infra: add telemetry fields & dashboard template (coordination)

Alex: Example admin API curl (admin-only):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/routing_policy" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"customer_id":"acct_123","policy":{...}}'
```

OpsBot: Canary recorded: use-case tags: low-latency search, APAC multilingual, enterprise residency.

DeployBot: Alex pushed branch routing/region-aware-latency-select -> CI started.

Alex: Will open PR once CI green. Thanks all.
